title: Avalara Predicts 2027 Will Be the Year AI Is Put to the Trust Test
headline: Avalara Predicts 2027 Will Be the Year AI Is Put to the Trust Test
summary: Executives at Avalara predict that enterprise AI adoption in 2027 will focus heavily on trust, accountability, and rigorous governance as agentic AI manages more complex business processes. A global survey of finance leaders in summer 2026 revealed that 30% had not updated internal controls for agentic AI, and 44% were only somewhat confident in explaining agent actions to auditors. Leaders emphasize that integrating strong financial controls, orchestrating multi-agent systems, and maintaining human oversight are essential for sustainable AI deployment.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying agentic AI must embed robust risk management, auditing, and human-in-the-loop controls directly into financial and compliance frameworks rather than treating governance as an afterthought.

quotes.text: In a global survey of finance leaders conducted in summer 2026, 30% of respondents had not updated internal controls in the past year to reflect agentic AI usage, while 44% were only somewhat confident they could explain an agent's actions to an auditor.
Risk-minded CFOs will recognise that AI governance isn't something to address after implementation. It's what makes adoption sustainable.

dates_mentioned.what: California Senate Bill 122 extends sales and use tax to certain prewritten software transactions, including software-as-a-service.
dates_mentioned.quote: Beginning January 1, 2027, the state will extend sales and use tax to certain prewritten software transactions, including software-as-a-service.

classification.significance_reason: Provides industry forecasts and survey data on financial controls for agentic AI, though it is primarily a vendor commentary piece rather than a binding standard.
